survivor_message: A city in flames. You were among the few survivors of the initial invasion. A catastrophic containment breach destroyed the once-thriving world of LV-759, home to a major Weyland-Yutani trading and industrial colony known as Hybris Prospera. By sheer force of will or cunning, you managed to escape the aliens' relentless onslaught... yet the nightmare remains.
announce_text: An automated distress signal has been received from the Weyland-Yutani colony of Hybris Prospera, a massive, city-like settlement renowned for its vast wealth, extensive mining operations, and thriving trade. Recently purchased outright from the ITM, this former colony is now a key asset for Weyland-Yutani, with a sprawling urban center home to thousands of residents and numerous smaller outlying colonies under its control. ###SHIPNAME### has been dispatched to investigate the situation.
